issues.title: Linter Script Implementation Gap
issues.why: The spec defines 6 mandatory linter gates (D3) but delegates their logic to sibling module spec/27. A mediocre AI without web access or the full spec/27 bundle cannot implement the validation logic.
issues.fix: Cite AC-SAG-30 and treat as a harness-artifact; implementation logic is owned by spec/27 slot registry.

issues.title: Walker-Pin Saturation Risk
issues.why: The module is ~136KB, exceeding standard 120KB bundle caps. Critical normative pins (AC-SAG-29/30/31) live at the end of the file and may be truncated for the AI.
issues.fix: The spec already includes a 'Walker-Pin' teaser in 00-overview.md to surface deep ACs early.

issues.title: Version/Phase Discrepancy
issues.why: Inlined schemas cite Phase 48/52 while the module banner is Phase 153, which might confuse an AI trying to reconcile 'current' state.
issues.fix: Cite AC-SAG-31: inlined-schema versions follow per-contract authoring phase, not module banner.
